interpretations: Group cases by `brokrepstat`, with NULL statuses forming one group. Compute each group’s `AVG(modelconf)`, ignoring NULL confidence values. Average the non-NULL group averages to get the baseline, giving each group equal weight. Return groups whose average exceeds the baseline, with their status, group average, difference from the baseline, and ratio to the mean of the qualifying groups’ averages. Return no rows if either reference mean is NULL; do not round.
queries:
WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT brokrepstat, AVG(modelconf) AS group_average
    FROM compliancecase
    GROUP BY brokrepstat
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT AVG(group_average) AS mean_average
    FROM group_averages
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT g.brokrepstat, g.group_average, b.mean_average AS baseline
    FROM group_averages AS g
    CROSS JOIN baseline AS b
    WHERE g.group_average > b.mean_average
),
qualifying_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(group_average) AS mean_average
    FROM qualifying
)
SELECT q.brokrepstat,
       q.group_average,
       q.group_average - q.baseline AS difference_from_baseline,
       q.group_average / m.mean_average AS ratio_to_qualifying_mean
FROM qualifying AS q
CROSS JOIN qualifying_mean AS m
WHERE q.baseline IS NOT NULL
  AND m.mean_average IS NOT NULL;
